_note: Decision table for the refused labels still pending on 2026-09-10 (refused-labels-status.json, applied=false). Each decision names its rule; the apply script only writes an alias when the archived evidence (alias-evidence.json) prints the label or the target on an official page (owner site, target site, or the employer's own catalogued portal). Perimeter questions are NOT decided here: they are listed for the owner. Wrong tenant bindings are source withdrawals, not aliases.
